Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding time restrictions on soliciting or accepting campaign contributions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to soliciting or accepting campaign contributions;reenacting and amending RCW 42.17.710 and 42.17A.560; providing aneffective date; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 42.17.710 and 2006 c 348 s 5 and 2006 c 344 s 31 areeach reenacted and amended to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) During the period beginning on the thirtieth day before thedate a regular legislative session convenes and continuing through thedate of final adjournment, and during the period beginning on the datea special legislative session convenes and continuing through the datethat session adjourns, no state official or a person employed by oracting on behalf of a state official or state legislator may solicit oraccept contributions to a public office fund, to a candidate orauthorized committee, or to retire a campaign debt. Contributionsreceived through the mail after the thirtieth day before a regularlegislative session may be accepted if the contribution is postmarkedprior to the thirtieth day before the session. (2) The restrictions of this section also apply to any incumbent of p. 1 SSB 5537a local elected office who has filed for a state office, or personsemployed by or acting on behalf of the incumbent of a local electedoffice. (3) This section does not apply to activities authorized in RCW43.07.370.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 42.17A.560 and 2006 c 348 s 5 and 2006 c 344 s 31 areeach reenacted and amended to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) During the period beginning on the thirtieth day before thedate a regular legislative session convenes and continuing through thedate of final adjournment, and during the period beginning on the datea special legislative session convenes and continuing through the datethat session adjourns, no state official or a person employed by oracting on behalf of a state official or state legislator may solicit oraccept contributions to a public office fund, to a candidate orauthorized committee, or to retire a campaign debt. Contributionsreceived through the mail after the thirtieth day before a regularlegislative session may be accepted if the contribution is postmarkedprior to the thirtieth day before the session. (2) The restrictions of this section also apply to any incumbent ofa local elected office who has filed for a state office, or personsemployed by or acting on behalf of the incumbent of a local electedoffice. (3) This section does not apply to activities authorized in RCW43.07.370.
Section 1 of this act expires January 1,2012.
Section 2 of this act takes effect January1, 2012.
